id: title:jabahamondes:cast the timestamp column in the dw goal health check

review.reason: Adds a STRING type and explicit toDateTime() wrapping for warehouse timestamp fields, with comments and regression tests. observations.behavior: Wraps warehouse timestamp field and constant in ClickHouse's toDateTime() function before comparison, and adds a regression test asserting this wrapping occurs.
